summary.text: Jeanine Driscoll is the Hempstead Town Receiver of Taxes and the Republican nominee for NY-4. An attorney for over 30 years, she was an associate village justice in Bellerose before winning town-wide office in 2019. Her campaign says she is running to restore the full State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction and lower the tax burden.

paragraphs.text: Lives in Bellerose, Nassau County, according to News 12.
Earned a B.A. in American government and politics from The Catholic University of America and a J.D. from Fordham University.
Worked as an attorney for more than 30 years before holding elected office.
Served as an Associate Justice for the Village of Bellerose from 2015 to 2019.
Elected Town of Hempstead Receiver of Taxes in 2019 (taking office in 2020) and re-elected in 2023.
According to her campaign website, as Receiver of Taxes she has helped homeowners with exemptions and lower assessments, and she serves over 95% of the 4th District.
Won the June 23, 2026 Republican primary for NY-4 after Nassau Republican Party leadership endorsed her.
